name: qui-react-development
description: QUI React best-practice workflows for application developers consuming @qualcomm-ui/react.

interface.shortDescription: Apply and audit QUI React best practices.
interface.longDescription: Provides separate Codex skills for applying QUI React best practices while writing application code and auditing existing React code that consumes @qualcomm-ui/react against the same rules enforced by @qualcomm-ui/eslint-plugin-react.
defaultPrompt: Use $apply-qui-component-rules when writing or modifying React code that consumes @qualcomm-ui/react.
Use $audit-qui-component-rules to review React code for QUI best-practice violations.
